owner_decision: Independent operational opening quantities, cost and locations without native accounting activation or financial journals.
acceptance: Owner can search the real MZ2 catalogue before any physical inventory exists.
Explicit product configuration, positive quantity, unit cost and storage location are reviewed before approval.
Preview has no writes; approval revalidates the preview and current owner permission.
The physical inventory writer remains default disabled; no automatic enablement.
One initial owner batch is atomic and idempotent; conflicting replay and existing stock fail closed.
No supplier debt, purchase invoice, native ledger, control changes or Salla writes.
Stock projection distinguishes recorded physical stock and operational cost from native financial valuation and fulfillment availability.
compatibility: Keep the existing native opening import and native financial/fulfillment guards unchanged. Existing stock needs reconciliation rather than automatic overwrite or adoption.
